statement: Every record the control plane and its hosts store carries a format and is read by one rule: a record without one is format 1; of a known format, members this version does not know are ignored, unless the record's crit names them (SNP-27); a later format is refused, as a format error, never read as absent. Policy documents, API keys and back-reference members are decision inputs and stay strict. A wrong value of any stored record is a format error, never an argument or JSON error a store would read as an outage.
guards: cocache:StoredRecordsTest#a wrong value of every stored record is a format error
cocache:StoredRecordsTest#every record with a format ignores what it does not know, reads one without a format, and refuses a later one
control:ChangeRequestCodecMessageTest#unknown members are ignored, and never quoted, by the reader's rule - CTL-53
document:ShadowCodecMessageTest#unknown members are ignored, and never quoted, by the reader's rule - CTL-53
